main_text.head: Confirmationis Argumentum i. ab authori-tate Scripturae hoc negantis.
main_text.p: Probetur tripliciter : 1. quia promissiones Evangelii perpetuò habent annexam conditionem fidei, pœnitentiæ & gratitudinis, quæ non est in reprobis. Illustretur aliquot dictis de præcipuis beneficiis.
main_text.l: 6. Gratia Dei Heb.11. Absque fide impossi-
main_text.p: Probatio ii. Quia infideles ab his beneficiis diserte excluduntur in Scriptura: &c. Ioh.3.36. Qui non credit super eum manet ira Dei. 1.Cor.6. Qui talia faciunt, &c. Rom.8.8. Qui in carne sunt, &c. Qui Spiritum Christi non habent, &c. Gal.4.30. Eiice ancillam, &c. Apoc.22.15. Foris sunt canes, &c.
Prob. iii. Quia infidelibus Scriptura minatur mala illis bonis contraria. Ioh.3.18: Iam condemnatus est: & 36. Ira Dei manet super eū, Mat.25. Ite maledicti in ignem æternum.
Obiectio. Excluduntur, & damnabuntur non propter peccata expiata, sed propter incredulitatem Ioh.3.18. Quia non credit, &c.
Respon. i. neg.conseq. quia posito uno peccato tanquam præcipua causa damnationis, non negantur alia.

page.notes: Numbering in the list is printed as "1." to "7."; the first item of the Probetur paragraph is set as "1." in the scan and was read as such. "1 im[?]" in the Eph. line is uncertain; the abbreviation may be "1 Tim". The "eū" in Mat.25 is a printed abbreviation with a tilde over u. Greek or Hebrew: none on this page. No marginal notes.
